verified_context: The required UI has an ellipsis in the card upper-right, a dropdown Archive choice and a separate confirmation step; opening or cancelling must leave data untouched.

actions currently takes operation expressions without a child body and concatenates protected forms. menu is implemented as navigation links; dropdown is a CSS focus wrapper without compiler lowering.

Saved prompted renderers arrange compiler-provided control HTML exactly once. They already admit actions. Delete confirmation, permission and concurrency controls belong to the canonical delete renderer and must remain there.

alternatives.A: Allow a control body under actions; distinguish it from the old expression header. Give that new body the shared overflow defaults and canonical entry-to-confirmation behavior, retaining old calls.
alternatives.B: Define a separate action_menu component word for a canonical control body and shared overflow/confirmation defaults. Existing actions remains expression-only.
alternatives.C: Complete dropdown slot lowering, compose a trigger plus canonical controls in its content, and require applications to specify placement. Canonical controls gain the necessary compact confirmation entry mode.
